title: 第十五章 友谊的力量第十六章 铁胆雄心母女情

天圆地方，东海之上。小舟载着众人，向着明珠堡垒的方向航行。船不大，人不少，加上新加入的螃惊蟹邪——虽然它大部分时间都缩在贝壳里睡觉——船舱里显得格外拥挤。
莉亚·塞莱娜将众人召至甲板。
“从今日起，船上的起居事务，由你们分工合作。”她取出一张纸，上面密密麻麻列着各种任务：打水、捕鱼、生火、做饭、清洗甲板、整理船舱……鹰捷看着那张纸，脸上的笑容逐渐消失。
“堡主……我们不是要去打坏蛋吗？”
“打坏蛋之前，先学会自理。”莉亚·塞莱娜语气平静，
“海上航行不是一日两日，总不能天天指望别人伺候你们。”她顿了顿，目光扫过众人。
“台焕，负责捕鱼。”
“鹰捷，负责生火做饭。”
“台灵，负责打水。”
“俄莹，负责清洗。”
“明玥，负责掌舵。”
“螃惊蟹邪……”她看向船头那只正在晒太阳的寄居蟹，
“你负责守卫。”螃惊蟹邪睁开一只眼。
“守卫什么？”
“守卫这艘船。”寄居蟹闭上眼睛，继续晒太阳。
“行吧。”于是，众人开始了海上航行的日常。鹰捷的
“演戏”从这一刻正式开始。他蹲在船尾的小炉灶前，手里举着一条刚从海里捞上来的鱼，眉头皱成一团。
“这个……怎么弄？”台焕正在船头收网，闻言回头：“你没做过饭？”
“没有。”鹰捷理直气壮，

“鹰城的厨房不让我进。”台焕沉默片刻。
“……那你怎么活到现在的？”
“吃干粮。”鹰捷指了指身后鼓鼓囊囊的粮袋，
“还有别人做的饭。”台焕叹了口气。他放下渔网，走到船尾，接过鹰捷手里的鱼。
“看着。”他拿起刀，刮鳞、剖腹、去内脏，动作行云流水，一气呵成。
鹰捷看得目瞪口呆。
“你……你怎么会的？”
“台城。”台焕简短地回答，
“母亲不在的时候，自己做饭。”他将处理好的鱼递给鹰捷。
“剩下的交给你。”鹰捷接过鱼，对着那堆柴火和铁锅，陷入了更深的迷茫。
他试图生火。木柴堆好了，火折子点了半天，冒烟，没火。再点，冒烟，没火。
又点，烟更大了，呛得他直咳嗽，火还是没着。小青鹰蹲在他头顶，被烟熏得眼睛都红了，却不肯飞走。
台灵提着一桶水路过，看见这一幕，忍不住笑出声。
“鹰捷哥哥，你这是在熏鱼还是烤鱼？”
“我在生火！”鹰捷涨红着脸，
“这柴太湿了！”台灵放下水桶，蹲在他旁边，接过火折子。她轻轻吹了口气，那火焰竟
“腾”地燃了起来。鹰捷：“……？？？”台灵眨眨眼睛：“玉兔龙教我的。”玉兔龙从她怀中探出头，朝鹰捷吐了吐舌头。
鹰捷：“……”他默默把鱼架上火堆。——演戏，要演全套。螃惊蟹邪很懒。
它趴在船头，贝壳被阳光晒得暖洋洋的，眯着眼睛，一动不动。偶尔有海鸟飞过，落在船桅上，好奇地打量它。
它连眼皮都懒得抬。鹰捷端着刚烤好的鱼，凑到它面前。

“喂，你不吃饭吗？”螃惊蟹邪睁开一只眼，看看那条鱼，又闭上。

The sky is round and the earth is above the East China Sea. The small boat carried everyone and sailed towards the Pearl Fortress. The boat was not big, but there were a lot of people, and with the new addition of Crab Xie - although it spent most of its time huddled in its shell and sleeping - the cabin seemed particularly crowded.
Leah Selena summoned everyone to the deck.
"From today on, you will divide the work and cooperate in daily life on the ship." She took out a piece of paper, which was densely listed with various tasks: fetching water, fishing, making fire, cooking, cleaning the deck, tidying up the cabin... Yingjie looked at the paper, and the smile on his face gradually disappeared.
"Fortmaster...aren't we going to fight the bad guys?"
"Before you fight the bad guys, learn to take care of yourself first." Leah Selena said calmly.
"Sailing at sea is not just a day or two. You can't expect others to take care of you every day." She paused and glanced at everyone.
"Tai Huan, responsible for fishing."
"Ying Jie, responsible for lighting the fire and cooking."
"Tai Ling, responsible for fetching water."
"Ruying, responsible for cleaning."
"Ming Yue, take charge of the steering."
"The crab is scared..." She looked at the hermit crab basking in the sun on the bow of the boat.
"You are responsible for guarding." Crab Xie opened one eye.
"Guarding what?"
"Guard the ship." The hermit crab closed its eyes and continued to bask in the sun.
"Okay." Then, everyone began their daily routine of sailing on the sea. Eagle's
"Acting" officially begins from this moment. He squatted in front of the small stove at the stern of the boat, holding a fish just caught from the sea in his hand, his brows furrowed.
"How... how to do this?" Tai Huan was closing the net at the bow of the boat. Hearing this, he turned around and said, "You haven't cooked before?"
"No." Ying Jie said confidently.
"The kitchen in Yingcheng won't let me in." Tai Huan was silent for a moment.
"...Then how do you survive until now?"
"Eat dry food." Ying Jie pointed to the bulging food bag behind him.
"There are also meals cooked by others." Tai Huan sighed. He put down the fishing net, walked to the stern of the boat, and took the fish from Yingjie's hand.
"Watch." He picked up the knife, scraped the scales, disemboweled the body, and removed the internal organs, all in one smooth motion.
Ying Jie was stunned.
"You...how did you do this?"
"Taicheng." Tai Huan replied briefly,
"When mother is away, cook by yourself." He handed the prepared fish to Ying Jie.
"I'll leave the rest to you." Yingjie took the fish and fell into deeper confusion facing the pile of firewood and iron pot.
He tried to make a fire. The firewood was piled up and the fire was lit for a long time, but there was smoke but no fire. Light it again, smoke comes out, but no fire.
He lit it again, and the smoke became even louder, choking him and coughing, but the fire was still out. The little green eagle squatted above him, its eyes red from the smoke, but refused to fly away.
Tai Ling passed by carrying a bucket of water and couldn't help laughing when he saw this scene.
"Brother Yingjie, are you smoking or grilling fish?"
"I'm making a fire!" Yingjie blushed,
"This firewood is too wet!" Tai Ling put down the bucket, squatted next to him, and took the firewood. She blew lightly, and the flame actually
"Teng" the ground burned up. Yingjie: "...???" Tai Ling blinked: "Jade Rabbit Dragon taught me this." Jade Rabbit Dragon poked its head out of her arms and stuck out its tongue at Yingjie.
Yingjie: "..." He silently put the fish on the fire. ——When it comes to acting, you have to do the whole thing. Crab Jing Crab Xie is very lazy.
It was lying on the bow of the boat, its shells warmed by the sun, its eyes squinted, motionless. Occasionally, a seabird flew over and landed on the mast of the ship, looking at it curiously.
It didn't even bother to raise its eyelids. Yingjie brought the freshly grilled fish to it.
"Hey, don't you want to eat?" Crab Jing Xie opened one eye, looked at the fish, and closed it again.
